_comment: Disk images published for this RomWBW release. 'upstream' is the path inside RomWBW-v<ver>-Package.zip; sizes and hashes are never written here, they are computed from the built artifact by tools/gen_catalog.py.

disks.name: Combo (Recommended)
disks.description: Six-slice disk: CP/M 2.2, ZSDOS, NZCOM, CP/M 3, ZPM3 and a word-processing slice, plus R8/W8 host file transfer on slice 0. Best starter disk.

disks.name: CP/M 2.2
disks.description: Digital Research CP/M 2.2 operating system with standard utilities.

disks.name: ZSDOS
disks.description: Z-System DOS - enhanced CP/M compatible OS with date/time stamping.

disks.name: ZPM3
disks.description: Z-System ZPM3 - enhanced CP/M 3 compatible with ZCPR extensions.

disks.name: CP/M 3
disks.description: CP/M Plus (CP/M 3.0), Digital Research's banked successor to CP/M 2.2.

disks.name: NZCOM
disks.description: NZCOM - Z-System implementation for CP/M 2.2 environments.

disks.name: QPM
disks.description: QP/M operating system, a CP/M 2.2 compatible alternative.

disks.name: Games
disks.description: Collection of classic CP/M games including adventures and arcade titles.

disks.name: Infocom Adventures
disks.description: Classic Infocom text adventures with an interpreter. New in RomWBW 3.6.0.

disks.name: Aztec C
disks.description: Aztec C compiler for CP/M - professional C development environment.

disks.name: BASIC Compilers
disks.description: Collection of BASIC compilers and interpreters for CP/M.

disks.name: COBOL
disks.description: COBOL compiler and runtime for CP/M. New in RomWBW 3.6.0.

disks.name: Cowgol
disks.description: Cowgol compiler - modern language targeting 8-bit systems.

disks.name: Fortran
disks.description: Fortran compiler for CP/M - scientific computing language.

disks.name: Hi-Tech C
disks.description: Hi-Tech C compiler - optimizing C compiler for Z80 CP/M.

disks.name: Turbo Pascal
disks.description: Borland Turbo Pascal 3.0 - fast Pascal IDE and compiler.

disks.name: Z80 Assemblers
disks.description: Collection of Z80 assemblers and development tools.

disks.name: Word Processing
disks.description: Word processing applications for CP/M. Replaces the WordStar 4 disk of RomWBW 3.5.1.

disks.name: Z3Plus
disks.description: Z3Plus - ZCPR3 command processor with enhanced features.

disks.name: B/P Bios
disks.description: B/P Bios utilities and tools disk.

disks.name: DOS/65
disks.description: DOS/65 - a 6502 operating system with a CP/M-like interface. New in RomWBW 3.6.0.

disks.name: MSX
disks.description: MSX support disk. New in RomWBW 3.6.0.

disks.name: MSX ROMs 1
disks.description: MSX ROM images collection - volume 1.

disks.name: MSX ROMs 2
disks.description: MSX ROM images collection - volume 2.
